lang_notice: Set the software's interface language. Requires a restart to take effect.
countdown_sec_notice: Countdown in seconds for a single video translation.
homedir_notice: Directory to save results (STT, TTS, TransSubtitles). Defaults to the 'output' folder.
llm_chunk_size_notice: When LLM Correction errors in the LLM large model, the number of subtitles sent each time is important. A larger value results in better sentence segmentation. Sending all subtitles at once is optimal, but this is limited by the maximum output token and context (max_token). An excessively long input may exceed the AI  limit and fail. The default is 20 subtitles.
llm_ai_type_notice: AI provider for LLM Correction errors
dont_notify_notice: Disable desktop notifications for task completion or failure.
noise_separate_nums_notice: The more threads used for separation of human and background voices, the faster the process, but the more resources it consumes.
uvr_models_notice: Select the model used when separating background noise.
batch_nums_notice: When translating in batches, set the number of lines to translate simultaneously in each batch here.
show_more_settings_notice: To avoid confusion caused by too many parameters, most parameters are hidden by default on the main interface. Selecting this option will switch to displaying all parameters by default.
process_max_gpu_notice: The number of GPU tasks that can be executed simultaneously should be set to 1 unless video memory very large
device_name_notice: Force the operation of heavy-duty equipment; do not tamper with it unless you know what you are doing.
bit8_notice: 8-bit quantization is used for qwen3-tts to reduce video memory usage.
crf_notice: Constant Rate Factor (CRF) for video quality. 0=lossless (huge file), 51=low quality (small file).
preset_notice: Controls the encoding speed vs. quality balance (e.g., ultrafast, medium, slow). Faster means larger files.
video_codec_notice: Video codec: libx264 (better compatibility) or libx265 (higher compression).
fps_mode_notice: When there is slow-motion video processing, variable frame rate (VRF) works better, while fixed frame rate (CFR) has better compatibility.
force_lib_notice: Force software encoding (slower but more compatible). Hardware encoding is preferred by default.
hw_decode_notice: When compositing videos, prioritize hard decoding; it's fast but prone to errors.
ffmpeg_cmd_notice: Custom FFmpeg command arguments, added before the output file argument.
threshold_notice: VAD: Minimum probability for an audio chunk to be considered speech.
max_speech_duration_s_notice: VAD: Maximum duration (s) of a single speech segment before splitting.
min_speech_duration_ms_notice: If a subtitle's duration is less than this value in milliseconds, attempt to merge it into an adjacent subtitle.
min_silence_duration_ms_notice: VAD: Minimum silence duration (ms) to mark the end of a segment.
model_for_recogn2_notice: The model used for secondary recognition (always using the Faster-Whisper channel)
max_speech_duration_s2_notice: Maximum speech duration (seconds) during secondary recognition. Limits the maximum length of a single speech segment. Forced segmentation occurs if this length is exceeded. Enter a number in seconds.
min_speech_duration_ms2_notice: Shortest speech duration (milliseconds) during secondary recognition. If a subtitle's duration is less than this value in milliseconds, attempt to merge it into an adjacent subtitle. Unit: milliseconds.
speaker_type_notice:
The model used for speaker separation. The default is the built-in model, supporting both Chinese and English. Pyannote is optional. 
If selected, you must have a token from 
https://huggingface.co 
and agree to the Pyannote licensing agreement. 
For details, please visit the URL for a tutorial: 
https://pvt9.com/shuohuaren
hf_token_notice:
Enter your token from huggingface.co. Otherwise, you cannot use Pyannote speaker separation. 
For details, please see the tutorial: 
https://pvt9.com/shuohuaren
cuda_com_type_notice: Compute type for faster-whisper (e.g., int8, float16, float32).
beam_size_notice: Beam size for transcription (1-5). Higher is more accurate but uses more VRAM.
best_of_notice: Best-of for transcription (1-5). Higher is more accurate but uses more VRAM.
condition_on_previous_text_notice: Condition on previous text for better context (uses more GPU, may cause repetition).
repetition_penalty_notice: Increasing this value helps reduce repetitions
compression_ratio_threshold_notice: Decrease this value helps reduce repetitions
gemini_recogn_chunk_notice: Number of audio slices per request for Gemini recognition. Larger values improve accuracy but increase failure rate.
zh_hant_s_notice: Force conversion of recognized Traditional Chinese to Simplified Chinese.
del_end_punc_notice: Remove punctuation at the end of subtitles?
asr_wait_notice: The number of seconds the cloud API pauses after each recognition to prevent exceeding the frequency limit.
trans_thread_notice: Number of subtitle lines per request for traditional translation.
aitrans_thread_notice: Number of subtitle lines per request for AI translation.
translation_wait_notice: Delay (in seconds) between translation requests to prevent rate-limiting.
aitrans_context_notice: The AI translation channel includes all original subtitles for reference.
dubbing_thread_notice: Number of concurrent threads for dubbing.
dubbing_wait_notice: Delay (in seconds) between dubbing requests to prevent rate-limiting.
remove_dubb_silence_notice: Removes the mute buffer at the beginning and end of each subtitle's audio, improving synchronization.
remove_dubb_all_silence_notice: Removes all mute buffers in each subtitle's audio, including the beginning, end, and pauses, audio-visual synchronization.
save_segment_audio_notice: Save the dubbed audio for each individual subtitle line.
edgetts_max_concurrent_tasks_notice: The higher the concurrent voice-over capacity of the EdgeTTS channel, the faster the speed, but rate throttling may fail.
edgetts_retry_nums_notice: Number of retries after EdgeTTS channel failure
max_video_pts_rate_notice: Maximum video slow-down rate. Default: 10 (cannot exceed 10).
cjk_len_notice: Number of characters per line for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean subtitles; more than this will result in a line break
other_len_notice: Number of words per line for subtitles in other languages; more than this will result in a line break
